contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Return largest element minus smallest element. For an empty array return zero; a one-element array also has range zero.
contract.domain: The array is dense, has at most 32 finite numbers between -100 and 100, and must not be modified. Any returned array must be fresh with independent storage.
contract.outputRole: maximum minus minimum, zero for empty array
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
